text.aria-label: Subtitle text '13 Primary substations, 365 daily forecast runs, July 2025 to June 2026. Frozen models, each trained on one year. Dot: estimate. Line: interval from re-drawing whole months (98.3% for the top two rows, 95% elsewhere). Zero: same score as the model trained on 2024-07 to 2025-06. Above zero: the old year is worse.'
text.tspan: 13 Primary substations, 365 daily forecast runs, July 2025 to June 2026. Frozen models, each trained on one year.
Dot: estimate. Line: interval from re-drawing whole months (98.3% for the top
two rows, 95% elsewhere). Zero: same score as the model trained on 2024-07 to
2025-06. Above zero: the old year is worse.
